Treatment summary
Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of neck pain and stiffness. Over the course of
twelve visits, care consisted of conservative management including gentle range-of-motion exercises, soft tissue therapy, and
home stretching instructions. Examination revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced cervical range of motion, which
are consistent with a soft tissue strain. Neurological screening, including reflexes, sensation, and strength testing in the upper
extremities, returned normal results. No prior injury to the cervical region has been reported in the patient's history. Treatment
followed an exepcted and typical course, with frequency of visits decreasing as symptoms improved and the patient was
discharged to independent home exercise. At this time, it cannot be determined with certainty whether the reported symptoms are
attributable to this collision, and further records may be needed to clarify causation. Billing records reflect single, non-duplicated
charges for each service rendered.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
